market.question: Will George Russell be the 2026 F1 Drivers' Champion?

assessment.reasoning: Russell is 2nd in 2026 F1 drivers' standings, 20 points behind teammate Antonelli after Miami GP, 4 of 22 rounds done. Base rate for 2nd-place driver this early winning is moderate (~25-30%); Antonelli's 3-race win streak signals real form. Market at 27.5% looks roughly fair; my independent estimate slightly lower at 22%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Antonelli's form sustainability and 18 races' worth of variance
